The hunting trip coincides with a sudden rainstorm, marking the immediate occasion for Zhou Jun's arrival at the Li household.
At the time of Zhou Jun's arrival, the male members of the Li family were absent, which is why Luoxiu handled the hospitality.
After the marriage, Luoxiu gave birth to Bo Ren (Zhou Yi) and his brothers, a later consequence of the union.
